models.scGPT: Cui et al. 2024 Nat Methods — perturbation-prediction head conditions on a perturbed-GENE token; no within-gene variant channel. (Using scGPT only as a cell-embedding provider reduces to embedding->regressor, already represented by our ESM heads.)
models.GEARS: Roohani et al. 2024 Nat Biotech — perturbations are nodes in a gene-gene GO graph, indexed by GENE; two alleles of a gene map to the same node.
models.STATE: Adduri et al. 2025 (Arc) — perturbations are one-hot perturbation identities; allele-blind for held-out variants as shipped.

mechanism: condition on perturbed-gene identity; identical prediction for all variants of a gene
resolution_coverage: 470 variant conditions collapse onto 4 gene-level representations
category_error: assigning these models an allele-level PDS is a category error (they cannot represent the distinction being scored)
empirical_anchor: Gene-mean reference (a gene-constant predictor) = PDS 0.478 [0.450, 0.504] on the canonical multi-seed path (results/canonical/definitive_summary.csv) -> gene-resolution models cannot discriminate alleles. An earlier note here quoted 0.468 [0.435, 0.501] from a superseded run.
resolution_coverage_note: The models can accept all 470 conditions; what they cannot do is distinguish them, because the perturbation representation is keyed to the perturbed gene. An earlier wording, '4/470 = 0.85% of benchmark variants representable', inverted that: it read as though only four conditions could be represented at all.
resolution_coverage_short_note: Short form for the printed manuscript panel; the long form above is the provenance record.
